18/** CSMP local/physical variable storage
19
20@author P. Lang
21@author S.K. Matthai
22@date 2007-2012
23
24@attention CSMP runs should be performed at least once in DEBUG mode with conceptual models to check validity of Read/Store calls. For performance, these checks are omitted in RELEASE.
25
26@section storees Storee Concept
27
28Storees have to follow:
29
30 - providing a @code PLACEMENT Placement() const { return PLACEMENT; } @endcode function, in which PLACEMENT is i.e. ELEMENT, NODE etc. (global csmp enum)
31 - in the assignment operator (and copy ctor), add: @code this->LVS( el.LVS() ); @endcode
32
33@section design Design
34
35We use CRT static polymorphism here to allow for non-virtual Placement() functions and exploit compile time type information.
36All methods specific to storees with integration points (Element, Face, InterFace) will fail AT COMPILE TIME when
37used for storees without integration points (Region, Boundary, SplitBoundary)
38
39@note Ideally we would like to use type traits instead of crt, but this would require change of csmp interface and wouldn't provide any performance increase
40
41@section implementation Implementation
42
43We store always in order: all ScalarVariable data/flags, then all VectorVariable data/flags, then all TensorVariable data/flags and finally all ArrayVariable data/flags
44At integration points this holds, whith all ELEMENT_INTEGRATION_POINT variables first (storing all such values for the first integration point, then for the second and so forth), then all SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT and last all FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT (for each IP)
45We perform validity checks on Read/Store etc in debug mode only, that is with no 'NDEBUG' symbol. Additional checks are activated if 'VARIABLE_STORAGE_DEBUG' is set.
46
47@attention The variable storage is implicitly coupled with the PropertyDatabase through the Index and its offset calculation performed there
48
49@todo (3-D) We could now even go for a single Read/Write function templatized on Variable type. Variable placement would then be needed to be available in variables.
50@note It's probably not sensible to merge duplicated functionality here for performance reasons
51@todo (2-D) DocMe (index arithmetic)
52*/

234 Data& operator=( Data&& d ) { flags=d.flags; data=d.data; return *this; }
235#else // for debugging more information is kept in storage

237 arrays{0}, flaggedArrays{0}, arrayLength{0}, flaggedArrayLength{0}
238 {}
239 Data( const Data& d ) : flags{d.flags}, data{d.data},
240 scalars{d.scalars}, vectors{d.vectors}, tensors{d.tensors},
241 arrays{d.arrays}, flaggedArrays{d.flaggedArrays},
242 arrayLength{d.arrayLength}, flaggedArrayLength{d.flaggedArrayLength}
243 {}
244 Data( const Data&& d ) : flags{d.flags}, data{d.data},
245 scalars{d.scalars}, vectors{d.vectors}, tensors{d.tensors},
246 arrays{d.arrays}, flaggedArrays{d.flaggedArrays},
247 arrayLength{d.arrayLength}, flaggedArrayLength{d.flaggedArrayLength}
248 {}
249 Data& operator=( const Data& d ) { if ( this != &d ) {
250 flags=d.flags; data=d.data; scalars=d.scalars; vectors=d.vectors; tensors=d.tensors;
251 arrays=d.arrays; flaggedArrays=d.flaggedArrays; arrayLength=d.arrayLength; flaggedArrayLength=d.flaggedArrayLength; }
252 return *this;
253 }

255 flags=d.flags; data=d.data; scalars=d.scalars; vectors=d.vectors; tensors=d.tensors;
256 arrays=d.arrays; flaggedArrays=d.flaggedArrays; arrayLength=d.arrayLength; flaggedArrayLength=d.flaggedArrayLength; }
257 return *this;
258 }
259 int_type scalars, ///< scalar variables stored at the site this policy is associated with
260 vectors, ///< vector variables at this site
261 tensors, ///< tensor variables at this site
262 arrays, ///< array variables at this site
263 flaggedArrays; ///< flagged array variables at this site
264
265 int_type arrayLength, ///< length of array variables associated with this site @todo only one size?
266 flaggedArrayLength; ///< length of flagged array variables @todo only one size?
267
268#endif // end debugging version of Data

289/**
290double Read( const csmp::INDEX<SCALAR,NODE>& ) const;
291*/
292template<uint32_t dim, template<uint32_t> class STOREE>
293template<PLACEMENT place>
294inline double LocalVariableStorage<dim,STOREE>::Read( const csmp::INDEX<SCALAR,place>& idx ) const
295 {
296 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariablePlacement<STOREE,place>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: STOREE type does not match PLACEMENT enumeration" );
297 assert( idx.index < data_.scalars );
298#if defined(DEBUG) && defined(CSMP_VARIABLE_STORAGE_DEBUG)
299 assert( idx.dataOffset < data_.data.size() );
300#endif
301 return data_.data[idx.dataOffset];
302 }
303
304/**
305
306void Read ( const csmp::INDEX<SCALAR,NODE>&, ScalarVariable& ) const;
307
308*/
309template<uint32_t dim, template<uint32_t> class STOREE>
310template<PLACEMENT place>
311inline void LocalVariableStorage<dim,STOREE>::Read( const csmp::INDEX<SCALAR,place>& idx, ScalarVariable& sc ) const
312 {
313 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariablePlacement<STOREE,place>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: STOREE type does not match PLACEMENT enumeration" );
314 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariableType<ScalarVariable,SCALAR>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: variable type does not match VARIABLE_TYPE enumeration" );
315 assert( idx.index < data_.scalars );
316#if defined(DEBUG) && defined(CSMP_VARIABLE_STORAGE_DEBUG)
317 assert( idx.dataOffset < data_.data.size() );
318 assert( idx.flagOffset < data_.flags.size() );
319#endif
320 sc.Flag() = data_.flags[idx.flagOffset];
321 sc = data_.data[idx.dataOffset];
322 }
323

326/// Scalar variable
327template<uint32_t dim, template<uint32_t> class STOREE>
328template<PLACEMENT place>
329inline void LocalVariableStorage<dim,STOREE>::Store( const csmp::INDEX<SCALAR,place>& idx, const ScalarVariable& sc )
330 {
331 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariablePlacement<STOREE,place>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: STOREE type does not match PLACEMENT enumeration" );
332 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariableType<ScalarVariable,SCALAR>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: variable type does not match VARIABLE_TYPE enumeration" );
333 assert( idx.index < data_.scalars );
334#if defined(DEBUG) && defined(CSMP_VARIABLE_STORAGE_DEBUG)
335 assert( idx.flagOffset < data_.flags.size() );
336 assert( idx.dataOffset < data_.data.size() );
337#endif
338 data_.flags[idx.flagOffset] = sc.Flag();
339 data_.data[idx.dataOffset] = sc();
340 }

374/// Vector, Tensor, FlaggedArray variable flag
375template<uint32_t dim, template<uint32_t> class STOREE>
376template<PLACEMENT place>
377inline VARIABLE_FLAG LocalVariableStorage<dim,STOREE>::Status( const csmp::INDEX<VECTOR,place>& idx, int_type i ) const
378 {
379 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariablePlacement<STOREE,place>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: STOREE type does not match PLACEMENT enumeration" );
380 static_assert( TemplateTypeMatchesVariableType<VectorVariable,VECTOR>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: variable type does not match VARIABLE_TYPE enumeration" );
381
382#if defined(DEBUG) && defined(CSMP_VARIABLE_STORAGE_DEBUG)
383 assert( i < dim );
384 assert( (idx.flagOffset+i) < data_.flags.size() );

549template<PLACEMENT place>
550inline void LocalVariableStorage<dim,STOREE>::Store( const csmp::INDEX<TENSOR,place>& idx, const TensorVariable<dim>& ts )
551 {
552 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariablePlacement<STOREE,place>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: STOREE type does not match PLACEMENT enumeration" );
553 static_assert( TemplateTypeMatchesVariableType<TensorVariable,TENSOR>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: variable type does not match VARIABLE_TYPE enumeration" );
554 assert( idx.index < data_.tensors );
555
556#if defined(DEBUG) && defined(CSMP_VARIABLE_STORAGE_DEBUG)
557 assert( (idx.flagOffset+dim-1) < data_.flags.size() );
558 assert( (idx.dataOffset+dim*dim-1) < data_.data.size() );
559#endif
560 const int_type dataOffset(idx.dataOffset);
561 const int_type flagOffset(idx.flagOffset);
562 for ( auto i{0U}; i<dim; i++ )
563 {
564 data_.flags[ flagOffset+i ] = ts.Flag(i);
565 for ( uint32_t j{0U}; j<dim; j++ )
566 data_.data[ dataOffset+i*dim+j ] = ts(i,j);
567 }
568 }

602 assert( av.Size() == idx.dataDepth );
603
604#if defined(DEBUG) && defined(CSMP_VARIABLE_STORAGE_DEBUG)
605 assert( (idx.dataOffset+idx.dataDepth-1) < data_.data.size() );
606 assert( (idx.flagOffset) < data_.flags.size() );

609 const int_type flags_offset( idx.flagOffset );
610 const int_type arraySize( idx.dataDepth );
611 for( uint32_t i(0); i < arraySize; ++i )

613 data_.flags[ flags_offset] = av.Flag();
614 }

702/// Scalar variable value at integration point

704template<PLACEMENT place>
705inline double LocalVariableStorage<dim,STOREE>::Read( uint32_t ip, const csmp::INDEX<SCALAR,place>& idx ) const
706 {
707 const int_type offset(DATA_OFFSET_IP);
708
709 static_assert( place == ELEMENT_INTEGRATION_POINT || place == FACE_INTEGRATION_POINT || place == INTER_FACE_INTEGRATION_POINT, "LocalVariableStorage: STOREE type does not match IP PLACEMENT enumeration" );
710 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariableType<ScalarVariable,SCALAR>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: variable type does not match VARIABLE_TYPE enumeration" );
711 assert( ip < IPS_SI );
712 assert( offset < data_.data.size() );
713
714 return data_.data[offset];
715 }

898 assert( ip < IPS_SI );

902 data_.flags[ flagOffset+i ] = flag;

1108// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1109// finite volume integration point variables (will fail at COMPILE TIME when used for storees without fv integration points)
1110// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1111
1112/**
1113 Scalar variable value at sector or facet integration points only.
1114*/
1115template<uint32_t dim, template<uint32_t> class STOREE>
1116template<PLACEMENT place>
1117inline double LocalVariableStorage<dim,STOREE>::Read( uint32_t sector_or_facet, uint32_t ip, const csmp::INDEX<SCALAR,place>& idx ) const
1118 {
1119 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariableType<ScalarVariable,SCALAR>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: variable type does not match VARIABLE_TYPE enumeration" );
1120 static_assert( place == SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT || place == FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT ||
1121 place == FACE_SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT || place == INTER_FACE_SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT ||
1122 place == FACE_FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT || idx.place == INTER_FACE_FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT,
1123 "LocalVariableStorage: STOREE type does not match VARIABLE placement" );
1124
1125 // offset to first instance of idx variable in the data vector
1126 const STOREE<dim>* const storeePtr = static_cast<const STOREE<dim>*>(this);
1127 const std::pair<int_type, int_type> offsetData = localVariableDispatch::containerOffset( storeePtr, idx );
1128
1129#ifndef NDEBUG
1130 if ( place == SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT ) assert( ip < IPS_SE );
1131 if ( place == FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT ) assert( ip < IPS_FA );
1132 assert( sector_or_facet < storeePtr->Facets() || sector_or_facet < storeePtr->Sectors() );
1133 assert( ip < storeePtr->IntegrationPointsPerSector() || ip < storeePtr->IntegrationPointsPerFacet() );
1134 assert( offsetData.first < data_.data.size() );
1135#endif
1136 const int_type sector_ip_offset = (idx.place == SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT) ?
1137 (sector_or_facet + ip) * idx.integrationPointVariables.ipvSector.totalDataDepth :
1138 (sector_or_facet + ip) * idx.integrationPointVariables.ipvFacet.totalDataDepth; // for facet integration points only
1139 /// ^^^^^^^^
1140 return data_.data[ offsetData.first + sector_ip_offset ];
1141 }
1142
1143

1145/// Scalar variable at facet or sector integration point
1146template<uint32_t dim, template<uint32_t> class STOREE>
1147template<PLACEMENT place>
1148inline void LocalVariableStorage<dim,STOREE>::Read( uint32_t sector_or_facet, uint32_t ip, const csmp::INDEX<SCALAR,place>& idx, ScalarVariable& sc ) const
1149 {
1150 static_assert( TypeMatchesVariableType<ScalarVariable,SCALAR>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: variable type does not match VARIABLE_TYPE enumeration" );
1151 static_assert( place == SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT || place == FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT ||
1152 place == FACE_SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT || place == INTER_FACE_SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT ||
1153 place == FACE_FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT || idx.place == INTER_FACE_FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT,
1154 "LocalVariableStorage: STOREE type does not match VARIABLE placement" );
1155
1156 const STOREE<dim>* const storeePtr = static_cast<const STOREE<dim>*>(this);
1157 const std::pair<int_type, int_type> offsetData = localVariableDispatch::containerOffset( storeePtr, idx);
1158 const int_type offset(offsetData.first);
1159 const int_type flagOffset(offsetData.second);
1160
1161#ifndef NDEBUG
1162 if ( place == SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT ) assert( ip < IPS_SE );
1163 if ( place == FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT ) assert( ip < IPS_FA );
1164 assert( sector_or_facet < storeePtr->Facets() || sector_or_facet < storeePtr->Sectors() );
1165 assert( ip < storeePtr->IntegrationPointsPerSector() || ip < storeePtr->IntegrationPointsPerFacet() );
1166 assert( offset < data_.data.size() );
1167 assert( flagOffset < data_.flags.size() );
1168#endif
1169 const int_type sector_ip_flag_offset = (idx.place == SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT) ?
1170 (sector_or_facet + ip) * idx.integrationPointVariables.ipvSector.totalFlagDepth :
1171 (sector_or_facet + ip) * idx.integrationPointVariables.ipvFacet.totalFlagDepth;
1172
1173 const int_type sector_ip_offset = (idx.place == SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT) ?
1174 (sector_or_facet + ip) * idx.integrationPointVariables.ipvSector.totalDataDepth :
1175 (sector_or_facet + ip) * idx.integrationPointVariables.ipvFacet.totalDataDepth;
1176
1177 sc.Flag() = data_.flags[flagOffset + sector_ip_flag_offset];
1178 sc = data_.data[offset + sector_ip_offset];
1179 }

1532inline void LocalVariableStorage<dim,STOREE>::Store( uint32_t sector_or_facet, uint32_t ip, const csmp::INDEX<VECTOR,place>& idx, const VectorVariable<dim>& vc )
1533 {
1534 static_assert( TemplateTypeMatchesVariableType<VectorVariable,VECTOR>::value, "LocalVariableStorage: variable type does not match VARIABLE_TYPE enumeration" );

1540 const STOREE<dim>* const storeePtr = static_cast<const STOREE<dim>*>(this);

1542 const int_type offset(offsetData.first);
1543 const int_type flagOffset(offsetData.second);
1544
1545#ifndef NDEBUG
1546 if ( place == SECTOR_INTEGRATION_POINT ) assert( ip < IPS_SE );
1547 if ( place == FACET_INTEGRATION_POINT ) assert( ip < IPS_FA );

1550 assert( offset+dim-1 < data_.data.size() );
1551 assert( flagOffset+dim-1 < data_.flags.size() );

1561 for ( uint32_t i{0u}; i<dim; ++i ) {
1562 data_.flags[ flagOffset + sector_ip_flag_offset + i ] = vc.Flag(i);
